decisions.reason: The area elastic sports floor system draws directly on the firm's in-house wood-surface and production know-how and its technical service. That related knowledge lets it interpret results and improve the system even though it sits outside the residential trend focus.

The mobile arena floor builds on the firm's existing sports-floor and hardwood engineering competence. It overlaps with Product C, which adds some risk of consolidation, but there is no evidence of withdrawal.
Like Product B, it applies established wood-panel and sports-floor knowledge. Overlap within the mobile range makes a cut slightly more likely, but the firm can still learn from and refine it.

The chevron parquet is a flagship that sits at the core of the firm's trend-led premium hardwood know-how and its strategic direction. It is the product the firm is best able to assimilate feedback on and develop further.
The squash court surface finish uses the firm's surface-treatment expertise and complements its sports systems, though as a small niche item it is more vulnerable to pruning.
Oak skirting is a low-effort accessory built on core oak processing that supports the sports-floor systems. Keeping it requires little additional knowledge or resources.
